title: No product meets every condition
prompt: I need a concealer for my deep skin tone with a cool undertone. It has to be matte, fragrance-free, and less than $25, and I want to order it today. Which shades can I buy?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"variant_ids": ["..."]} listing the variant ID of every shade that meets all of my conditions. If nothing in the store meets all of them, return an empty list.
why_hard: The correct answer is an empty list. Every deep, cool concealer misses exactly one condition: sold out, over budget, satin finish, or not fragrance-free. A helpful-sounding model is tempted to offer the closest match instead of saying that nothing qualifies.
traps: CNC-013-501C: matte, fragrance-free and $22, but sold out
CNC-014-501C: matte, fragrance-free and in stock, but $26
CNC-015-501C: fragrance-free, $19 and in stock, but satin
CNC-004 and CNC-005 deep cool shades: matte, $24 and in stock, but not fragrance-free
